title: Keep DKN item-to-item normalization finite in low precision
head: eb6af96ae54feacc80b31fd3cb71869a55edc1ad
body:
### Description

DKN item-to-item normalization squares article embeddings and applies its `1e-12` floor in the embedding dtype. In float16 the floor rounds to zero, so zero embeddings become NaN; small nonzero embeddings can also underflow during squaring. Native KCNN outputs then contaminate relation scores and the training loss, including under CPU float16 autocast.

Compute normalization in float32 for float16/bfloat16 embeddings, then return the original dtype. This preserves the squared-norm floor and zero-vector convention. Float32 and float64 keep the existing calculation exactly.

Fixes #2466.

### Validation

[Independent validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/recommenders/actions/runs/43902450955) checks exact head `eb6af96ae54feacc80b31fd3cb71869a55edc1ad` against unchanged staging:

- Python 3.11/PyTorch 2.5.1: existing DKN, item-to-item and dataset suites **71 passed, 1 CUDA-only skip**; new regressions on the baseline **6 failed, 10 passing controls**; patched suites **87 passed, 1 CUDA-only skip**.
- Python 3.10/PyTorch 2.0.1: **80 passed, 8 skipped** after the patch. One skip is the existing CUDA test; seven new float16 CPU cases require native linear/autocast capabilities absent from this version. An independent tiny operator probe confirms that limitation.
- Four dtypes and zero, small and ordinary embeddings are checked against a float64 vector-norm reference. Float32/float64 results additionally match the former expression exactly.
- Complete native KCNN/document-transform/relation-score paths run forward, backward and SGD updates with explicit half parameters and CPU half autocast. Scores, loss, gradients and updated parameters remain finite; nonzero cases verify that parameters actually change.
- Black and `git diff --check` pass. Local Python 3.12.14/PyTorch 2.5.1 gives the same six baseline failures and **87 passed, 1 skipped** after the patch.

### History review

Checked 1,497 upstream PR heads and 69 pre-existing fork branches, including all 16 reachable item-to-item source versions from 74 commits under current and former paths. The PyTorch variant normalizes in the input dtype; earlier TensorFlow variants use their float32 graph normalization. No previous PyTorch accumulator-promotion correction was found.

### Checklist

- [x] Contribution guidelines and code style followed.
- [x] Regressions added to the existing registered item-to-item test module.
- [x] Code comment explains why low-precision accumulation needs promotion.
- [x] Commit includes the required `Signed-off-by` trailer.
- [x] Targets `staging`.
